title: Stay informed: press releases, data and resources
content:
Find the latest press releases, figures and facts about packaging recycling – all in one place. You'll also find downloadable materials from press conferences, along with pictures, videos and other content.

On this press and media page, you will find:

We publish press releases and additional materials to keep you informed – clearly and concisely – about key developments, facts and figures, and other topics related to the work of the ZSVR and the LUCID Packaging Register.

In agreement with the German Environment Agency (Umweltbundesamt), the Zen-trale Stelle Verpackungsregister (Central Agency Packaging Register – ZSVR)…

The Osnabrück Administrative Court has dismissed multiple claims against classifica-tion decisions made by the Zentrale Stelle Verpackungsregister…

The Cologne Administrative Court has dismissed the claim brought by a grocery retail company contesting a classification decision made by the Zentrale…

The importance of waste separation for packaging recycling was at the centre of our press conference with the UBA on 21 January 2025.

The clock is ticking – companies that sell their goods in packaging are required by law to enter into a system participation agreement for 2025 and…

If you have any press-related questions, please don't hesitate to contact our Head of Communications and Press at any time.

Dr Bettina Sunderdiek

Head of Communications and PressPhone: +49 541 201971-13E-mail: presse@verpackungsregister.org

Receive the latest updates directly to your inbox. To join our press distribution list, please send an e-mail to presse@verpackungsregister.org.

By signing up for our newsletter, you will get essential information on producer responsibility and recyclability delivered to your inbox every two months. You will also receive guidance on the requirements of the German Verpackungsgesetz (Packaging Act), the European Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) and other recent developments.

Follow us on LinkedIn to access the latest information and insights about the ZSVR's work.

The Verpackungsgesetz (Packaging Act) has set recycling targets by material type that system operators must achieve. The systems collect, sort and recycle the packaging waste that accumulates in Germany. Each year, the ZSVR reports on the actual recycling rates of packaging volumes managed by these systems.

The degree of system participation is calculated based on the participation volumes and the market volumes of packaging that is subject to system participation. However, it is important to note that the ZSVR does not have access to the market volumes for this packaging; these must be determined through market research studies. Additionally, data for the pandemic years is neither representative nor comparable due to market distortions and new deposit regulations. It is not clear at present when a new study makes sense.

From press kits and fact sheets to photos and videos – a wide range of materials is available for download here. Details about the terms of use can be found under each section. You can also listen to our podcast episode 'Nachgefragt! Der Erklärcast der ZSVR' here (available in German only).

If you need additional material or have a specific question, please send an e-mail to presse@verpackungsregister.org.
